## Context / Problem

Attestation staleness errors currently say the plan changed in the fixed list "description/AC/file_impact/children". That is misleading: AC is not an independent material key, checkbox state is normalized out, and the message does not identify the component that actually changed. Operator approval: fix this broadly anywhere rebar reports an attestation refusal, including additive signed-manifest metadata, while preserving all gate outcomes.

## Confirmed RCA

`material_fingerprint()` hashes a single composite basis. Current `origin/main` keeps the basis single-sourced in `material_diff.material_basis`: `ticket_id`, normalized `description`, `file_impact`, `children`, and conditional `file_impact_scope`; `pass1.material_fingerprint()` hashes that basis. Checkbox state is removed by `normalize_checkbox_state()`, so ticking `- [ ]` to `- [x]` is attestation-safe. Because the composite hash is one-way and older manifests lack per-component values, stale-material readers could not name what changed and sometimes named the fictional `AC` component.

## Plan

Add signed per-component material fingerprints as deterministic additive `material-part: <name> <hash16> <size>` manifest lines. Parse them leniently and use them only for diagnostics. On stale-material, compare signed parts with live parts and render the changed component(s) plus compact sizes; legacy manifests fall back to child-pin add/remove diffs when possible, otherwise say the component cannot be named and advise re-review. Update every attestation-refusal surface that drops or rewrites the underlying reason so it forwards or reconstructs the same specific reason.

Invariant: no gate outcome changes. Edits may only add manifest diagnostic lines or change `reason` text for already-failing branches. Do not change branch conditions, verdict names, thresholds, or valid/invalid decisions.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/material_diff.py`: per-component material hashing and explanation.
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/manifest.py`: emit/parse additive `material-part:` lines.
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/attest.py`: named stale-material reasons and timestamped stale-reopened reasons.
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/attest_gate.py`: actionable unsigned message and complete verdict docs.
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/generation.py`: named own/dependency material drift.
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/resign.py`: named plan drift in sign-review recovery.
- `src/rebar/llm/completion_child_gate.py`: forward child closure signature reason.
- `src/rebar/_cli/_llm_commands.py`: sign-aborted rendering that names reason/remedy.
- `docs/plan-review-gate.md`: document checkbox-safe and named staleness reasons.
- `tests/unit/plan_review/test_94a3_material_diff.py`: regression coverage.

## Testing

Run the new material-diff unit tests first RED and then GREEN, then run the related existing suites: `tests/unit/test_compute_validity.py`, `tests/unit/test_legacy_material_grandfather_96d1.py`, `tests/unit/test_attestation_invalidation.py`, `tests/unit/test_plan_material_pins.py`, plus `pytest tests/unit tests/integration` for the requested full gate.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `material_components(ctx)` exposes exactly the material basis keys, and changing one component changes only that component hash.
- [ ] `build_manifest` emits sorted `material-part` lines; `manifest_material_parts()` round-trips them; manifests without lines parse to `{}`.
- [ ] `compute_validity` stale-material reasons name changed components for description-only, file-impact-only, and children-only edits, never `description/AC/file_impact/children`.
- [ ] Tick-only checkbox edits remain `verdict == "certified"`.
- [ ] Legacy raw-description attestations over unchanged tickets remain certified.
- [ ] Un-grandfatherable legacy attestations say the changed component cannot be named.
- [ ] `stale-reopened` names signed and reopened timestamps.
- [ ] `unsigned` names both `review-plan` and `sign-review` remedies.
- [ ] `plan_review_sign_aborted` with `store-read-failure` renders that reason and does not advise `sign-review`.
- [ ] Generation-time dependency material drift names changed dependency ticket ids.
- [ ] Touched branches preserve the prior `(valid, verdict)` outcome.
- [ ] Relevant unit and integration tests pass.
- [ ] Documentation states plainly that ticking an AC checkbox is attestation-safe.
